patches.decision_note: Book-title artifacts, chapter-heading hierarchy, and recurring callout styling have separate targets and modification or failure trajectories and should be independently represented.
The generic completion statement concerns three enumerated dedication and copyediting corrections, not implementation of the broader manuscript-version fidelity Requirement.
The missing Dedication page is already represented under the narrower Dedication Page Content Requirement and should not be duplicated under a broad fidelity Requirement.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’ve completed the review. Here is my feedback:

1. Page1 contains only the image and no text. Is that how it is meant to be? For the cover, will there be no text at all? How will it appear when printed?
2. Page 2 contains only the title, subtitle, and author name, with no image. IS this the intended format?
3. The text says Published in India by "Being Mindful Parents". Will I be able to change this later?
4. The images for the chapters listed below appear elongated. If you tell me the required size, I can try generating them in that size so they do not look strange.
- Chapter2
- Chapter4
- Managing the In-Laws
- For the Partner
5. In Chapter7, the image is cropped at the top right. Once I receive the correct size details, I can share this one as well.
6. I removed the full stop from the table text.
7. In Chapter12, the punctuation of the first line is different. Specifically, the first letter of every word is in Caps. In the previous revision, the first line appeared as a subtitle, while the following lines were body text starting on a new line and using normal punctuation. In this revision, both lines are at the same level, so the first line’s punctuation seems out of place.
8. I made a few minor text edits. They are available through track changes.
9. Could you advise me about the front and back matter content that is required? Is anything else necessary for publishing?

ambiguity.description: The client is uncertain whether the interior title page should contain only the title, subtitle, and author name without an image.

patches.decision_note: The client explicitly raises a material title-page composition question earlier than the currently recorded title-page history.
The evidence does not safely establish whether back matter, back content, and author lines form one interior deliverable, exterior back-cover copy, or multiple independently evolving Requirements.
Attachment context is needed to determine whether the last-two-lines and final-paragraph deletions target the Dedication page or another manuscript section.
Message 191 is a generic affirmation and the listed non-adjacent context does not establish within the supplied evidence that it confirms the authoritative manuscript file as final.
